info.title: GitHub Actions Docker registry login workflow

diffs.patch:
Index: .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml
===================================================================
--- .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml	
+++ .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml	
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+name: Docker publish
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+    tags: ["v*"]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+env:
+  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
+  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
+
+jobs:
+  build-and-push:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      packages: write
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
+        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
+
+      - name: Log in to the container registry
+        uses: docker/login-action@v3
+        with:
+          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
+          username: ${{ github.actor }}
+          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels)
+        id: meta
+        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
+        with:
+          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
+
+      - name: Build and push
+        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
+        with:
+          context: .
+          push: true
+          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
+          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

input.content:
name: Docker publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to the container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels)
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

parts.text:
Created `.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml`, which:
- Authenticates to `ghcr.io` with `docker/login-action` using `GITHUB_TOKEN` (granted `packages: write`)
- Logs in **before** the `docker/build-push-action` step that pushes the image

Notes:
- Assumes an image builds from a `Dockerfile` at the repo root. If yours lives elsewhere, set `file:`/`context:` on the build step.
- To use another registry (Docker Hub, ECR, etc.), change `REGISTRY` and the login `username`/`password` secrets.
